nodes.name: Download Audio from S3
nodes.notes: Downloads the audio file from the S3 presigned URL as binary. Stored in $binary.data for the next node.

nodes.name: Transcribe with Groq Whisper
nodes.notes: Sends audio file to Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) via multipart/form-data. Returns { text, language, duration }.

nodes.name: Callback Laravel
nodes.notes: POSTs { message_id, transcription } to Laravel. Laravel saves the transcription then dispatches ProcessMessageJob → W1 takes over.
